title: Heinrich Weber: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Author record for Heinrich Weber in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page keeps Weber material together by author: original-language modern LaTeX reader PDFs, current English translation drafts, and source/artifact files.

Status at a glance.

  • Original-language modern LaTeX readers: [##--------] Lehrbuch der Algebra Bands 1 and 3 are front-facing here.
  • English translation: [######----] Volume II preface, sections 1-8, and current continuations on abelian groups, bases, invariants, group characters, reciprocal groups, Lagrange resolvents, linear substitutions, transposed substitutions, projective actions, binary substitutions, absolute invariants, form problems, Galois groups, metacyclic groups, abstract groups, alternating groups, orthogonal groups, and fractional linear groups are front-facing here.
  • Source/artifact preservation: [##########] available TeX, component PDFs, rendered translation pieces, and provenance are in the artifact ZIP.
  • Proofreading/final edition status: [----------] working drafts for checking, not certified critical editions.

The organization is by author, not by language. Readers can download the original-language reader PDFs and the English translation PDF separately from the file list, while complete sources and intermediate renders live in the artifact ZIP.
notes: Public author record: original-language and translation material are grouped together under Weber.
